title: Primary Care Provider Assignment Continuity Window by Eligibility Category and Recent Treatment
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment — the continuity window for continuity-of-care referrals.**

For the continuity visits recorded on a continuity-of-care referral, the period after the exit date during which the member may keep seeing the exiting provider is the continuity window set out here, in place of a fixed continuity-of-care period for every member in active treatment.

**Clause.** The continuity window depends on the member's eligibility category and recent treatment: a member whose plan membership (**Medicaid Managed Care Membership**) is in the **Prairie Ridge ABD Care** or **Prairie Ridge Dual Complete** category and who had at least **3** visits (the active-treatment count) with the assigned provider in the last quarter receives the extended continuity window of **135 days**; a member who meets exactly one of those two conditions receives the intermediate continuity window of **105 days**; a member who meets neither receives the practice type's continuity-of-care days.

The last quarter is a trailing period of **3 whole months** counted back from the handling date, not a calendar quarter: a visit is inside it when fewer than 3 whole months separate its date from the handling date, so a visit dated exactly 3 months back is outside it.

**Schedule**

| Category is Prairie Ridge ABD Care or Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | Visits with the assigned provider in the last quarter | Continuity window |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 3 or more | 135 days |
| Yes | 0 to 2 | 105 days |
| No | 3 or more | 105 days |
| No | 0 to 2 | The practice type's continuity-of-care days |

**Both sides of the visit threshold (hypothetical members in Prairie Ridge Family Care)**

- 3 visits with the assigned provider in the last quarter: one condition met, 105 days.
- 2 visits: neither condition met, the practice type's continuity-of-care days.

**Quarter boundary (hypothetical, handling date 15 September 2026).** Visits on 16 June, 20 July and 25 August 2026 are all inside the last quarter: three visits. Had the first visit been on 15 June 2026, it would be exactly 3 months back and outside, leaving two.
